# Priority Dispatch LLC - LLM Context

## Company Overview
Priority Dispatch LLC is a premier freight dispatching service based in Kissimmee, Florida, founded by Muhammad Faisal Bilal. We specialize in providing 24/7 dispatching services for owner-operators and small trucking companies across all 48 continental United States.

## Services
- Freight Dispatching (Reefers, Dry Vans, Box Trucks, Flatbeds)
- 24/7 Carrier Support
- Load Booking & Rate Negotiation
- Back-Office & Invoicing
- Route Optimization
- Broker Vetting & Compliance
- New Carrier Setup & MC Authority Assistance
- Detention & Claims Support

## Key Information
- **Founded by**: Muhammad Faisal Bilal (BS Computer Science, University of Gujrat)
- **Location**: Kissimmee, Florida
- **Service Area**: All 48 Continental United States
- **Contact**: Available 24/7
- **Website**: https://prioritydispatchllc.com
- **Pricing**: 5% commission on gross revenue, no hidden fees, no long-term contracts

## Value Proposition
- Average 18-25% revenue increase for carriers
- 150+ active carrier partners
- 4.9/5 average carrier rating
- Dedicated dispatcher for each carrier
- No setup fees, cancel anytime

## Target Audience
- Owner-operators
- Small trucking companies
- Independent carriers
- New carriers entering the industry
- Investors looking to start trucking businesses

## Competitive Advantages
- Technology-driven dispatch using data science and route optimization
- Transparent pricing with no hidden fees
- 24/7 support with real human dispatchers
- Expertise across multiple equipment types
- Fast payment processing (5-7 business days average)
